Kd: Dissociation constant. Concentration of ligand at which half of the sites are occupied at equilibrium, for a 1:1 Langmuir isotherm. Units M. The peptide CaM–M13 Kd in ORIGAMI is a literature slot, not a fusion measurement.
persistence_length: Worm-like-chain bending length of the CTPR contour. Used only to decide whether the screw is treated as rigid versus a 15 nm WLC cutoff. Not a measured persistence length of the fusion.
C_eff: Effective concentration of one tethered module at the other, from a Gaussian-chain model of the linker. Units molar. Not a bulk molarity in the tube.
physics_score: Ranking score (1 − clash probability) × log10(1 + C_eff / 1 mM). The 1 mM denominator is a ranking convention, not a measured Km.
calibrated: False until the team approves a wet dataset for a named claim. A green test run is not calibration.
fidelity: 0 = dry (physics or computational score). 1 = wet plate y. CamSol is fidelity 0.
CamSol: Sequence-based intrinsic solubility score (CamSol). Method: Sormanni & Vendruscolo 2019, DOI 10.1101/cshperspect.a033845. Dry. Not a measured soluble fraction.
Phillips_Tm: Melting temperature from the Phillips 2012 CTPRa DSC length model. Not a melt of the Spy–CTPR–LgBiT fusion.
